title: Middle Eastern Fish Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy wrap filled with grilled fish, topped with a tangy slaw and served with a side of warm flatbread.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with the Middle Eastern Spice Mix and grill for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix together the shredded red cabbage, grated carrots, and sliced cucumber in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and Greek yogurt.
Add the hummus to the lemon yogurt mixture and stir to combine.
To assemble the wraps, place a piece of flatbread on a flat surface and top with a grilled fish fillet, followed by a spoonful of the slaw and a dollop of the tahini sauce.
